integrity: All numerical orbit and basin counts are proved by finite support-class enumeration and local phase arguments, with independent direct-state checks through six pages. Literature comparisons are limited to inspected available sources; independent external audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labelled edge-glued quadrilateral books and exact synchronous three-state threshold-one excitation only. The universal finite-entry theorem uses an exhaustive 4599-case support-state reduction; it is not an extension to arbitrary graphs.
title: Exact three- and four-phase excitation on quadrilateral books
